description: This file implements mathematical trigonometric functions such as sine, hyperbolic sine, arcsine, and inverse hyperbolic sine, with support for array inputs and input validation.

classes.name: Sine
classes.description: Provides static methods for trigonometric functions such as sine, hyperbolic sine, arcsine, and inverse hyperbolic sine with array support.

methods.name: sin
methods.description: Calculates the sine of an angle, supporting array inputs and validating arguments before calling the native PHP sin() function.

methods.name: sinh
methods.description: Calculates the hyperbolic sine of an angle, supporting array inputs and input validation.

methods.name: asin
methods.description: Calculates the arcsine (inverse sine) of a number, supporting array inputs and input validation.

methods.name: asinh
methods.description: Calculates the inverse hyperbolic sine of a number, supporting array inputs and input validation.
